<issue>Issue Title: feat(rag): migrate and upgrade mem0 integration under the new unified abstraction
Description:
## Background
This issue is blocked by #1664, which defines the base abstraction for the unified RAG and long-term memory module. Once the abstraction is finalized, we need to:
1. Migrate the existing mem0 integration from v1.0 to conform to the new interface
2. Upgrade the integration to support the latest version of the mem0 library, as a newer version has been released since the v1.0 implementation
## Changes
- Add a new `mem0`-based implementation of `XxxBase` that is compatible with the new unified abstraction
- Ensure backward compatibility with the v1.0 mem0 integration where applicable
- Support the latest mem0 API and features
## Dependencies
- Blocked by #1664 (base abstraction definition)
</issue>
